expansion_limit: matching exact-reference expansion count; separate from model calls
scheduler: deterministic rounds, one request per active episode per round, stable task/cell/seed ordering
cache_scope: adapter and episode isolated; clear on adapter change
concurrent_torch_ports: distinct explicit MASTER_PORT per launch, recorded with GPU mapping

required_probes: scalar versus batch semantic operation and runtime result
repeated batch semantic operation and runtime result
actual processor token/image limits in every occupied input-size bin
hardware_qualification.precision_fallback: none; failure requires a successor freeze
coverage_order: cheapest complete task per domain per family by exact-reference decisions, ties by task ID; additive settings remain paired

clock: one monotonic clock per development matrix attempt, including qualification; never reset on resume
progress: flush stage, completed/total, elapsed seconds and ETA; heartbeat at most 30 seconds apart during long work

outcomes.PASS: all applicable frozen criteria and complete selected coverage
outcomes.VALID_STOP: ordinary resource or threshold failure; gated-not-run receipt
outcomes.INVALID: semantic replay, parity, provenance or permission mismatch; never scientific completion
outcomes.ANCESTOR_STOP: blocking predecessor did not pass; gated-not-run receipt
